Overview

About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

AI agents are becoming the web's primary user, and Parallel builds the web infrastructure they rely on. You will own the experience of every developer, and every agent, that builds on Parallel. Our Developer Experience team is responsible for how developers and their agents discover, sign up for, integrate, and grow with Parallel, from the first API call to production scale.

Developers need to not only succeed in solving their problems with Parallel, they need to love the experience that they get while doing so.

We are looking for new grads or early career engineers who have built with AI themselves and bring strong product instincts about what makes a great developer experience.

What you will do:

Build and ship product features that make it fast and intuitive for developers to build on Parallel

Design and build the backend systems behind our developer facing product, including billing and entitlements

Talk with developers, understand where they get stuck, and turn that feedback into improvements

Own projects end to end, from idea to launch, alongside a small team of experienced engineers

What we are looking for:

A BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field

You have built and shipped something with AI, whether at an internship, in a project, or on your own

Strong software engineering fundamentals and comfort working across the backend and product

Strong product sense and genuine excitement about building tools for developers

Curiosity, humility, and a bias toward shipping

Life at Parallel

We believe in a fully in person work culture 5 days a week. We’re building strong offices in San Francisco, Palo Alto, Austin, and New York. Your office and in office days will depend on your team, and we will walk you through the details during the interview process. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.

We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

Own customer impact: It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.

Obsess over craft: Perfect every detail because quality compounds.

Accelerate change: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.

Create win-wins: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.

Make high-conviction bets: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount.

Competitive salary

401K plans

Daily lunch & office snacks
